## Søren Kierkegaard on self

Søren Kierkegaard (1813–1855) approaches self within Christian existentialism. Truth is subjectivity: appropriation matters more than objective surplus of results. Stages of life—aesthetic, ethical, religious—name existential spheres, not mere theories. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets self most directly—useful for searches such as “søren kierkegaard quotes on self.”
